audience: warehouse and inventory managers who track stock and orders in Finale Inventory

useCases.title: Check stock of a product across locations
useCases.text: The AI sums quantity on hand, on order and reserved for a SKU, in total and per location or sublocation.

useCases.title: Review open purchase and sales orders
useCases.text: The AI lists orders by type and status with dates and totals, and opens one for its line items, supplier or customer, and shipments.

useCases.title: Follow shipments and stock transfers
useCases.text: The AI lists shipments, purchase receipts and transfers with status and tracking code, and stock transfers between locations.

useCases.title: Look at products, suppliers and past stock counts
useCases.text: The AI reads product details such as cost, suppliers and reorder guidelines, lists customers and suppliers, and lists recorded stock adjustments from counts.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft purchase order for a supplier
useCases.text: The AI creates a purchase order as an editable draft for a supplier. It is not committed, received or emailed, so you review it in Finale first.
